mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0%, it signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE down and PAYEMS up) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production slowdowns (INDPRO declining for two consecutive months), manufacturing output contraction signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers central bank hawkishness and reduces real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, which typically accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS up and HOUST up) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high consumer spending (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars), robust demand supports sustained corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 500000.
